pages.name: Vienna Game: Paulsen Variation, Mariotti Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Rxh4 and ...Qh4 before White's Nxh4. Rewrote it around ...hxg3 and the h-file; British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Pierce Gambit, Rushmere Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qe1-h4 and Qf3 (the f3-pawn and g4-bishop cover it) and an open f-file blocked by Black's pawns. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Vienna: 2...Bc5 3.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the b1-knight to g3 though it stands on c3; plan 4 had ...Na5 with no knight on c6. Rewrote plans 3 (Nge2 to keep the f-pawn free; first wording rejected by the reviewer, revised) and 4; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Vienna: 2...Bc5 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had the dark-squared c5-bishop exchanging itself for the knight on the light f3-square; plan 3 'or b5' read as a pawn move. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; plan 2 now says ...d6 defends e5; British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Vienna Hybrid, Spielmann Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an ambiguous Ne2-g3 route; plan 4 put White's Bg5 and f4-f5 in a Black plan. Rewrote plans 1 (Nge2 to keep the f-pawn free; first wording rejected by the reviewer, revised) and 4; British spelling in overview and plans 2-3.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Falkbeer Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 put White's f4 in a Black plan; plan 4 wrote 0-0. Reworded; British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Mieses Variation, Erben Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Nxc6 before dxc6 and ...Qb6 against a d4-pawn that isn't there; plan 3 called the c- and d-files open. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling and O-O in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Stanley Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Na5 with no knight able to reach a5. Rewrote it (...Nc6 and ...Bc5/...Bb4, or 3...Nxe4 with 4.Nxe4 d5 and 4.Qh5 Nd6); British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Stanley Variation, Reversed Spanish
pages.notes: Overview and plans called ...Bb4 a pin, but the d2-pawn blocks the line to the king, and called ...Bxc3 a check. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Na5 with no knight on c6. Added ...Nc6; British spelling in overview and plans 2-3.
